clips.title: The story
paras: At Bael Modan, a relic called the Tear of the Moons has left Feegly the Exiled mad and obsessed. General Twinbraid has locked it away as a curse, but Feegly still demands its return.

The dwarves found the Tear of the Moons while cutting into the southern Kalimdor hills for Bael Modan. It was their first major discovery, and its strange influence fell at once on Feegly, one of the expedition's workers.

Feegly claimed the Tear granted him immense power and turned violently on his comrades to protect it. General Twinbraid saw the relic's corrupting hold, called it cursed, took it from Feegly, and secured it in the keep. Banished from the excavation camp, Feegly took refuge among the cliffs. Bitter and obsessed, he begs passing travelers to steal the Tear back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!
Those dirty excavators uncovered it... So beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.
It should have been mine! Mine I say!
General Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!
Others wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.
Now I want it back. Back I say!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
